newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Eight killed in jailbreak in Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in jailbreak in Kazakhstan.

text.p: Eight people, including a mother and her four-year-old daughter, were killed in the course of a bloody jailbreak in Kazakhstan, an Interior Ministry official said on Tuesday.

Also among the dead was one of two convicts who staged the escape attempt from a special labour camp in the north of the former Soviet republic, at the weekend. The other was wounded in an exchange of gunfire with police and recaptured.
The two convicts, one serving seven years and the other 15, made their getaway after killing three guards, seizing their Kalashnikov rifles and taking one man hostage.
Outside the camp they hijacked a car, shooting the driver dead, and then abandoned it for another vehicle, killing the 24-year-old woman owner and her four-year-old daughter.
Police gave chase and a gun battle developed in which the hostage and one of the convicts died and the second escapee was badly wounded, the official said.
